data.subject: Local Ledger four-week fund pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FCBM and AVBH.

On September 18, 2026, FCBM disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1531193/000110465926108950/tm2625756d1_8k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer Endeavour a four-week fund pilot.

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
